main_text.l: gloriam, dolentque quòd plebs defertis sa-
cerdotibus & scribis Domino adhæreret.
Adiunt ergo confertim Pharisæi. Et quam-
quam insidias Christo tendunt, & dolosè
eum adoriuntur ut circumueniant. utiliter
tamen nobis cessit eorum malitia[?]: ficuti
Dominus mirificè in tuorum utilitatem con-
vertere novit, quæcunque ad veræ doctrinæ
subversionem machinantur impii. Nam
hac occasione soluta fuit quæstio, quam pa-
riebat repudii libertas, & de sacro ac infolu-
bili[?] coniugii nexu certa lex tradita. Inde
autem arrepta est captionis ansa, quia in
utranque partem secundum ipsos non nisi o-
diosa esse poterat responsio. Nam quæstio
admodum insidiosa est, ut si neget Christus
atque damnet divortium, objiciant ei Mo-
sem, clamentque, impiè ab ipso legem abro-
gari, Deut.24. quæ permittit quavis de cau-
sa dare repudii libellū, ac dimittere: sin per-
mittat simpliciter, dicant esse magistrum li-
centiæ & corruptelæ morum, imo lenonem
potius quàm Dei prophetam, qui sic viro-
rum libidini indulgeat: aut secum pugnare,
quum prius docuerit, non licere repudium,{*}
Matth.5. Hoc quidem animis conceperant.
Sed filius Dei (qui novit sapientes in astu-
tia sua deprehendere) eos frustratus est i-
llicitis repudiis severè refistens: & simul ta-
men demonstrans nihil se nisi legi consen-
taneum proferre.
Nam duobus capitibus
totam rem concludit: ordinem creationis

page.notes: Page number "283" is read from a worn scan and is uncertain. Running head read as NUPTIALES. after correcting the printed V to U. "malitia" is printed with a break ("malit a") and is uncertain. "infolu-" at the line end is hard to read; the word is probably insolubili. "libellu," is read as libellū with a macron for the omitted m. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Two inline references appear in the running text: "Deut.24." and "Matth.5.", kept in place as printed. The asterisk after "repudium," is a reference mark with no matching note on the page. Left-edge and bottom stains are not transcribed. The final line appears heavier than the body but is part of the running text.
